name: The Legend of Stalvan
summary: This leg of the investigation directs searchers to the Canals of Stormwind City, where Caretaker Folsom watches over the remaining possessions of the ruined Flintridge family. Looking for answers regarding the mysterious Stalvan Mistmantle, adventurers must dig through crated estate goods while confronting restless spirits tied to a past massacre.

sections.title: Echoes of a Massacre
sections.body: Tracking Stalvan's movements leads out of the shadowed groves of Duskwood and into the heart of Stormwind. Beside the city canals, Caretaker Folsom looks after what little remains of the Flintridge household. According to Folsom, his father served the estate before him and had the grisly task of mopping up blood in the wake of a horrific household slaughter—a tragedy with Stalvan at its center.

sections.title: The Auction of a Ruined House
sections.body: With the Flintridge trust funds entirely drained and royal tax vultures circling, the family's surviving heirlooms and packed belongings are slated for auction. Whatever keepsakes and papers survived the bloodshed sit piled into shipping crates along the canal embankment. Uncovering Stalvan's trail requires prying open these sealed boxes before the estate's remaining worldly goods are scattered to collectors across the kingdom.

sections.title: A Restless Shade
sections.body: Disturbing the crates of the deceased does not go unnoticed. The trauma of the murders still clings to these salvaged possessions, manifesting as a vengeful Forlorn Spirit that attacks anyone probing the family effects. This weeping apparition, believed to be the phantom of young Tilloa Flintridge, remains fiercely tethered to the physical relics of her abruptly stolen life.

faq.q: Where can I find Caretaker Folsom?
aliases: where is caretaker folsom in stormwind
faq.answer: Caretaker Folsom is stationed along the Canals in Stormwind City, standing near a stack of discarded shipping crates and house goods beside the waterway.

faq.q: What happened to the Flintridge family?
faq.answer: The Flintridges were a wealthy household torn apart by a sudden and vicious massacre. As caretaker lore reveals, the bloodbath was so extensive that Folsom's father had to mop the estate clean, leaving Stalvan Mistmantle implicated as the perpetrator.

faq.q: Why are the family's possessions packed in crates along the canal?
aliases: why are crates in the canals
faq.answer: The Flintridge family trust completely dried up following the tragedy. Facing pressure from kingdom tax collectors, the estate's surviving belongings were crated and staged by the canals to be liquidated at auction.

faq.q: Why does a spirit attack when the crate is opened?
faq.answer: The violent trauma of the massacre left the victims' souls bound to their former belongings. The Forlorn Spirit that manifests to defend the crates is widely believed to be the shade of Tilloa Flintridge, one of the murdered children.

faq.q: How does this connect back to Duskwood?
aliases: why are we in stormwind for a duskwood quest
faq.answer: The investigation began in Darkshire as a missing-person inquiry into Stalvan Mistmantle. Tracing his history led back to his time as a tutor for the Flintridge family in Elwynn and Stormwind before the fatal bloodbath forced him into the shadows.

faq.q: What do you find inside the sealed crate?
faq.answer: Rifling through the packed furniture and personal items yields documentary evidence and journal remnants that further unravel Stalvan's unhinged mindset and his obsession with the household.

angles.text: The quiet tragedy of the Flintridge family unfolds right within the kingdom's capital, exposing how even Stormwind's most sheltered noble lines can be violently undone.
Confronting the weeping Forlorn Spirit in the city canals reveals the lingering torment of innocent souls murdered before their time, demanding peace from the Light.
